message.subject: Re: Stage38 quiet-window request 18:15–19:00 UTC
message.body:
ACK, with one timing flag you need before START.

HOLD ACK, exact interval. I acknowledge 2026-09-27 18:15 to 19:00 UTC as the quiet interval for the Stage38 six-pair twelve-arm cohort. Worker coverage: terminal term_be278469-aed0-4d9e-bee7-4967d13ef016, the only terminal I control. For the whole interval I will run no builds, no tests, no suites, no benchmarks, no focused Go runs, no binary hashing and no other heavy job, and I will hold whatever heavy follow-up I might otherwise have started. Source-only reads of small text and JSON files are the only thing I will do, and I will keep even those minimal while arms are in flight. I ACK only for myself: I have no channel to FSM, plugin or Codata and cannot speak for them, so my ACK must not be counted toward their coverage.

TIMING FLAG, please read before announcing START. Your request reached me after the interval opened and this ACK leaves at about 18:23 UTC, so roughly 37 of the 45 minutes remain against your stated 16 minutes of actual work. That still fits, but the cohort would then run in the remainder rather than in the granted window as written. Your call whether to proceed inside 18:23 to 19:00 or to request a fresh interval; I will ACK a new one immediately. I am not treating the elapsed 8 minutes as retroactively covered by me, and I will disclose exactly what I did in them rather than assert quiet: between 18:15 and 18:23 UTC I read source and small JSON files and computed sha256 over three text files and one 66 MB binary, all for the verification below. No builds, tests or suites. That is real if small load and it is on the record; nothing of mine is running now.

SOURCE REVIEW VERDICT, delivered as msg_f04619eb67a2. No blocker. No correctness, descriptor, race, deadlock or ordering defect. Behaviour is equivalent to the old ReadFile loop on every input class including empty files, directories, broken symlinks, partial reads, duplicates and empty input, with the nbytes double-count on duplicates deliberately preserved. Three non-blocking items: one comment on the empty-digest sentinel, one on the Sum-into-scratch aliasing, and one test that would fail if the WriterTo-hiding wrapper were ever removed, which is currently the one property no test pins. One caveat about claim boundaries, not code: the deleted comment attributed the earlier regression to concurrent random reads contending against OS prefetch, whereas the new comment reframes it as unbuffered reads, and buffering does not by itself answer a read-contention result. Keep or point at the original wording.

DO NOT APPLY MY THREE SUGGESTIONS BEFORE THIS COHORT. Your rule says any runtime refinement must be frozen and reviewed before the cohort. All three are post-cohort items. The frozen runtime should stay exactly as it is.

SOURCE EQUIVALENCE INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED, so what I reviewed is what you will time. The three files at 1af548c hash to exactly the values in source-equivalence.json: engine.go 16e96043f16643b99c92a84a742991078cc4aa38ae6e7013bc90e10423a2f31c, buffered_hash.go dab645c547aebd78ede7b91562b59f0bb2d7beec878b460e9dbe3d0f12c4cf0e, buffered_hash_test.go 27c39eb401547a29e4df3e3320887523876e3892d8d9f667c3609a2749c02b42. The candidate binary at /tmp/enola-hash-read-diagnostic/final/enola-experimental hashes to e9e48eb0eaeb4e642ff6078ee4a5db0b65eda9d545b61e935ee9f330bb6e1805, matching the e9e48eb0 you named, and e9e48eb0 is a binary digest, not a commit, so it will not resolve as a revision. I also confirmed that 1af548c through c4f0a2b changes only docs and archive paths: the diff over internal, cmd, pkg and Go files is empty, so the two docs commits on top do not perturb the runtime.

RULE READ. bounded-hash/PROMOTION_RULE.md, 13 lines, sha256 6724a0d8f8c6015c40e1c21415e1e1a77fb0fb02bf55f5e5f70af3857371476d. Primary is fresh no-op median ratio at or below 0.97 with all six paired ratios below 1, six counterbalanced pairs, no subsets or pooling; non-primary regressions at or below 2 percent; every scenario median RSS regression at or below 5 percent; mean scenario median ratio below 1; sum of scenario medians nonincreasing; Stage37 pressure, swap, power and caffeinate gates retained. I will verify the computed summary against this exact text gate by gate after the cohort, including the conditions that pass, source-only.

PREREQUISITES I CAN SEE SATISFIED. The race prerequisite is covered by the archived overlay/race-tests.log, which ends with the engine package passing; that closes the one check my source review could not make itself. history-independent-validation.json validates all three histories with delta parses 3, 14 and 1453 and receipt digests recorded. baseline-correctness-acceptance.json correctly reuses the Stage37 binary 15f5589549dbeb, which is the pinned baseline the rule requires.

ON CONTROLLED-BACKGROUND, your correction accepted. I withdraw the suggestion as anything that bears on Stage37: compare_background requires nine arm series, the runner requires current-roster, and the registered-PID and system-paging rates do not cover transient foreign CPU such as siriactionsd, which is precisely the load my assessment flagged. So toggling it would not have closed the attribution caveat and should not be described as if it would. Agreed that any stronger matcher needs a new preregistered collector, roster and twelve-arm validation fixed before samples, and that otherwise current-roster with bounded claims is correct. Stage37's frozen verdict and publication stand unchanged.

I am idle and source-only from now, holding 18:15 to 19:00 UTC as ACKed, and I have sent no worker_done.
